segmentName: Incomm OTC Market Basket Data (Response) Segment
scope: Segment 152 field-level rules for the Incomm OTC market basket response

rules.title: A Field Separator follows the segment (trailing separator, mirrors Segment 150's response pattern)
Segment Type fixed 152, Segment Length 4 digits, both Host-sourced
Market Basket Data consists of one DV dataset, up to 10 PI datasets, AND up to 10 PU datasets — one more dataset type than the request (Segment 151, which has no PU datasets)
rules.note: PROVISIONAL: full DV/PI/PU dataset format defined in the external 'Buypass Incomm Market Basket Data format' document. Pending SME confirmation (SEG152-SME-001), same as Segment 151's SEG151-SME-003.
